goal: Replace proof-of-concept blockout geometry with production-ready Unreal assets without disturbing locked office coordinates, anchors, camera, or Isabel behavior.
locked: CAMERA_ARRIVAL transform and lens after approval

cabinetry.pivot_rule: align to existing BACK_WALL and monitor group centerline

desk.method: production mesh centered on locked desk transform
do_not: move desk to fix camera composition

must_match: seat height compatible with Isabel sit anchor

floor.method: material replacement only unless geometry issue found

validation: No replacement changes any anchor coordinate.
No replacement changes camera transform/focal length after camera lock.
No replacement changes screen aspect ratios or IDs.
Isabel can still complete desk sit/stand and all four screen approaches.
Arrival view remains within approved composition tolerances.
NavMesh remains continuous around desk and monitor approach points.
